title: Model Artifact
description: Identity and provenance of the immutable output of one successful Training Run (Architecture Baseline section 7.5). Supports reproducibility and traceability only. Storage mechanism (where/how the artifact bytes are persisted) is intentionally not modeled here, since the storage mechanism itself is an open Architecture Baseline decision (section 31.6); no model registry concept is introduced. Model name/version information is reachable via training_run_id and is not duplicated on this schema.

training_run_id.description: The Training Run that produced this artifact. Exactly one artifact per successful Training Run.

artifact_hash.description: Checksum identifying the exact artifact content.
